'''Aomei''' is an NPC in {{Location|Jinzhou}}.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(During the day)
:'''Aomei:''' It's a brand new day. Time to get to work!
:'''Aomei:''' The [[Moon-chasing Festival]] is almost here. The city will be bustling with new and exciting activities!
:'''Aomei:''' We need to be extra vigilant to ensure everyone's safety, just like [[Chixia]] said!

;(During the night)
:'''Aomei:''' Ah... I'm really feeling a bit tired after a whole day.
:'''Aomei:''' After work, let's head to [[Panhua]]'s Restaurant for dinner, then chat with the teahouse owner, and maybe...
:'''Aomei:''' Oh, right! We need to see the Hero Play. How could I forget?
:'''Aomei:''' I've heard the special show for the Moon-chasing Festival will begin soon, though its details are still a mystery.
{{Dialogue End}}
